system.description: You categorise a foe within 60' as "non-existent". Reality attempts to correct the error.

outcomes.success: The foe takes 3d10 damage. If this reduces it to 0 HP, it leaves no corpse and is forgotten by all but you. The Dark Master may rewrite one fact about the world to account for its absence.
outcomes.failure: Half damage, and nothing is forgotten.
outcomes.ruin: Reality corrects the wrong error: until your next Long Rest, no one remembers who you are. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
